name: VideoVault Premiere Extension
releaseNotes:
- August 6, 2026
- adds a manual `Repair Links` action so editors can restore VideoVault-managed source and proxy links after Premiere opens into a slow or mixed relink state
- sharpens the full-resolution checkout UI so the 4K local workflow is visible in both the ready-to-cache and project-ready states
- adds internal documentation and a browser preview page so the team can review the current panel flow before packaging or release
- repairs manifest-tracked source links back to the preferred local or server mode from one panel action
- repairs manifest-tracked proxy links for the same project state and then saves the Premiere project in place
- persists preferred source and proxy targets in the manifest so recovery uses the editor's last intended mode
- adds a standalone preview page for the current source-checkout and repair UX
- this is a patch release on top of `1.10.0`
- this release is intended to ship on both Windows and macOS
